parsed.reason: The parent asked a parenting question about when to start solids — grounded in Theo's age of 5 months. The reply gives a concrete, actionable answer: ~6 months, watch for head control and food interest, wait a few more weeks. No greeting, no sign-off, no markdown, no referral, no invented detail. This is exactly the shape the product requires for a raising-kids question.
